tagline: Manage ClickUp tasks and get updates directly inside Slack
metaTitle: Slack + ClickUp Integration: Tasks from Emoji Reactions
metaDescription: React to a Slack message to create a ClickUp task, get task updates in Slack, and a daily ClickUp digest. GAIA keeps your lists current. See the setup steps.
intro:
Teams coordinate in Slack but their work lives in ClickUp. Decisions made in channels don't always make it to tasks, and progress updates don't reach the team in chat. GAIA bridges the two so communication and task management work together.

With GAIA, any message can become a task in seconds. Task completions get celebrated in Slack. Overdue tasks alert the right people in chat. Your team spends less time switching between apps and more time doing actual work.

useCases.title: Create tasks from messages with emoji reactions
useCases.description: React to any message with a task emoji and GAIA automatically creates a task from the message content, posted in the configured list with the message context preserved.

useCases.title: Task update notifications in Slack
useCases.description: When tasks change status, are completed, or become overdue, GAIA posts intelligent updates to the relevant channel so the team stays informed without checking ClickUp.

useCases.title: Daily ClickUp digest in Slack
useCases.description: GAIA posts a morning digest to each team member's DM summarizing their tasks due today and any overdue items, which makes prioritizing easy.

useCases.title: Sprint summary posts
useCases.description: At the end of each sprint, GAIA posts a summary to the team channel showing completed tasks, incomplete items carried over, and velocity metrics.

useCases.title: Blocker escalations
useCases.description: When a task is marked as blocked, GAIA sends an alert to the task owner and project manager so blockers get addressed immediately rather than sitting unnoticed on the board.

howItWorks.step: Connect Slack and ClickUp to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Add GAIA to your workspace and authorize your ClickUp account. Map channels to lists and spaces.

howItWorks.step: Set up task creation and notification preferences
howItWorks.description: Configure your preferred task creation method and which events should generate notifications. Start with task completion and blocker alerts.

howItWorks.step: GAIA bridges chat and task management
howItWorks.description: From the moment you connect, GAIA routes action items from chat into tasks and task updates back to chat, keeping both in sync automatically.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create ClickUp tasks with subtasks from Slack?
faqs.answer: Yes. If you describe a task with multiple components in chat, GAIA can create a parent task with subtasks. You can also ask GAIA to add subtasks to an existing task from the channel.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support custom statuses when posting updates?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA reads your custom statuses and uses them in notifications so updates reflect your actual workflow stages rather than generic status names.

faqs.question: Can I control which lists generate notifications?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can enable notifications for specific lists, folders, or spaces and mute others. This prevents low-priority lists from cluttering your team channels.
